name: EH3D-PHOENIX-CNC
build: cargo build --release --features gui; cargo test --features gui
notes: EH3D-PHOENIX-CNC is the machine-control program of the PHOENIX family (violet phoenix), formerly EH3D-MOTIONCNC. Scaffolding v0.0.9: the EH3D machine-control program. A window (phoenix-cnc, feature gui) over the controller interface of eh3d-controller in EH3D-COMMON (a sibling folder is needed), working on a simulated machine only: position, jog, zero, home, a line of commands, a G-code program run line by line with pause, stop and the emergency stop, and its path drawn on the table; five themes and eight languages. Nothing has run on a real machine, and no serial port or network connection is opened.
